_catalog_note: Beastman tier - not in setting-lore §5.2; demographics from ax_domains_of_chaos.xml (catalog 5.3). Naming/totemic flavor only.
homeland: no fixed homeland (foul caves, stink-pits, foul-water deeps)

branch.regression: hisses + clicks (s/sh/ts -> long hiss sss, t -> tch-click, q -> click, suffix -ssk/-tk/-isss)
branch.nature: primitive reptile cave-dwellers; foul-smelling, blind-crawling, savage
branch.model: Kazhur rotted into a troglodyte's hiss and click

_note: Beastman culture: TROGLODYTES, primitive reptile cave-dwellers - Kazhur rotted into hisses and clicks (qatal 'kill' -> Tch'atass-k). Foul-reeking, savage, blind in the deep dark. ALWAYS CHAOTIC; totemic shamanism (race-totem the Reek / the Blind Crawler). Deity-morphs Gul- prefixed. Mechanically stripped (catalog 5.3).

phonology.palette: Troglodyte (Kazhur, hiss-click regression): s/sh/ts -> long hiss (sss), t -> tch-click, q -> click, suffixes -ssk/-tk/-isss; foul, sibilant, primitive.
phonology.phonotactics: hiss-heavy CVC with click onsets; low primitive hiss.

morphology.naming_marker: named with a hiss by the kasssk; a foul hiss-click name.

title_ladder._note: Mapped to the ACKS 7 civ tiers (the shared system; not a perfect fit) by how many clanholds a leader rules - barony = chief of one clanhold (lowest governing leader), empire = the great horde-lord over hundreds. thrall/warrior are NOT governing roles (see non_governing_ranks).
title_ladder.government: clanhold / cave-clan (mapped to the civ 7-tier ladder by clanholds ruled)

march.scope: war-chief of a frontier / raiding clanhold

empire.scope: the great horde-lord over hundreds of clanholds

religion._note: CHAOTIC, totemic. Race-totem the Reek / the Blind Crawler. The Kasssk hisses to the totem and the Gul-spirits in the foul dark; foremost Gul-Metensu the Rot/Reek (the trog's foul stink is sacred); the One and the sun demonized (cave-blind, they hate the light).

venerated.Metensia (rot, reek, filth): Gul-Metensu (the Rot-Spirit; the sacred stink; supreme)

demonized.Tulrius (the sun, light): Tarul the Burning-Eye (the light that blinds and burns)

religion.shaman_rites: hiss-chants in the stink-pit; the marking with foul musk; the blind-crawl rite.

holy_symbol_motifs.Reek: a wavering stink-haze over a coiled crawler
holy_symbol_motifs.Gul-Metensu: a rotting carcass crawling with vermin

banks_patterns.war_bands: the hiss-named clans: 'the Reek', 'the Blind-crawlers', 'the Scale-backs of [chief]'
banks_patterns.lairs_dungeons: foul caves, stink-pits, and foul-water deeps: 'the Reek-cave of [clan]', 'the Stink-pit of [chief]', 'the Foul-deep of [name]'
